idea-plugin.name: Earl Grey UI Theme
idea-plugin.description: A gentle, low-contrast light UI theme for IntelliJ-based IDEs, following the design principles of Earl Grey (https://earl-grey.halt.wtf/). Aligns tool window backgrounds (Project, Structure, etc.), editor syntax highlighting, and Java/file-type node icons with the Earl Grey palette. Java syntax highlighting is matched token by token to the Earl Grey VS Code theme with Red Hat's Java extension. Borderless, solid-color icon style throughout, except folder icons which use an outlined style. Custom-built for personal use; some New UI (expui) icon paths were reverse-engineered via UI Inspector rather than sourced from official JetBrains assets, so exact vector fidelity to stock icons is not guaranteed.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
@VERSION@

  • Java highlighting now matches the Earl Grey VS Code theme: method names, type parameters, annotations, fields, constants, parameters, record components, Javadoc tags and punctuation were previously falling back to IDE defaults because the scheme used key names IntelliJ does not know.
  • Every Java color key is now set explicitly, so no stock colors (purple fields, underlined reassigned variables) show through.
  • Diff, search, inlay hint, inspection and console colors from the Earl Grey palette.
  • Colors for the Rainbow Brackets (Lite) plugin; set its number of colors to 6 to get VS Code's bracket pair colors.
